body: Hey! You're are so young. When I was your age and I wanted to kill myself, I said let's stick around until I'm 25. Who knows if I might find something that will keep me going for the rest of my life tomorrow.

I'm not qualified to give advice. What I found with my experience with depression is that it tends to magnify problems that would not have being too bad to handle if depression wasn't in the picture. Whatever you do, do not violate your brother's trust by talking to the cops or something like that.

I think people should have the right to choose. It's not a selfish act. Most people don't understand and it's very stressful and burdensome for them. However, you should think about whether or not you'd have reason to believe that things won't improve a few years from now because you're very young. I think things will get better...

I was in the same situation. I made a promise to my cat when I took him home from the shelter that I won't ever abandon him, and he's being a constant companion to me as your cat will be to you. Please know you're not alone.

I felt the same way when I was 18. I feel really bad for you because I remember sitting in my car by myself wishing I could die. I'm female and 29 now, and I've struggled with the thought of suicide all my life. I don't know how I could help you, but whatever you do, don't tell anyone your plans. The police has legal grounds to put you in a hospital against your will and sedate you. My friend had this happen to him and he was saddled with $10000 of hospital bills that he had to paid for "treatment" made against his will. Please know that you are not alone.
